items.name: Homemade egg and cheese breakfast burrito, low-carb tortilla, butter
items.portion: 1 burrito: 2 eggs, 1/4 cup cheese, 1 low-carb tortilla, 1 pat butter
items.source: USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy records 171287 (whole raw egg), 173414 (cheddar), 173410 (salted butter); actual user-supplied tortilla Nutrition Facts label photo (71 g serving).
items.note: User reported breakfast made by mom: 2 eggs and 1/4 cup cheese in a low-carb tortilla, cooked with a pat of butter. Egg count and cheese volume are user-confirmed. Egg size assumed large (50 g edible each); cheese type unknown, cheddar proxy at approximately 28 g shredded; butter pat assumed 5 g, all consumed. Tortilla nutrients are confirmed from the actual user-supplied label: one tortilla (71 g). Brand appears Mission but exact variant is not fully visible; no exact SKU asserted. Total carbs include fiber, not net carbs. Label calories retained independently of 4/4/9 arithmetic. Raw egg reference models ingredients before cooking with butter counted separately. No meat, salsa, extra oil or other unreported ingredients included. Whole meal remains estimated because eggs, cheese and butter use portion/type assumptions.
